description_en: Queries the backup file information of an ApsaraDB for Tair (Redis® OSS-Compatible) database instance
description_zh: 查询云数据库 Tair（兼容 Redis）实例的备份文件信息
name: DescribeBackups

parameters.help_en: The ID of the backup file
parameters.name: backup_id

parameters.help_en: The ID of the backup job. This ID is returned by the CreateBackup operation. If CreateBackup returns multiple BackupJobIds, you must call this operation to query each of them separately
parameters.help_zh: 备份任务ID，由CreateBackup返回，CreateBackup若返回多个BackupJobId，则需要使用本接口分别对其查询
parameters.name: backup_job_id

parameters.help_en: The maximum number of entries per page. Valid values: 30, 50, 100, 200, and 300
parameters.name: page_size

parameters.help_en: The page number. The value must be greater than 0 and cannot exceed the maximum value of the Integer data type. Default value: 1
parameters.help_zh: 页码，取值大于0且不超过Integer数据类型的最大值，默认值为1
parameters.name: page_number

parameters.help_en: The start time of the query. Specify the time in the yyyy-MM-ddTHH:mmZ format. The time must be in UTC
parameters.name: start_time

parameters.help_en: The end time of the query. The end time must be later than the start time. Specify the time in the yyyy-MM-ddTHH:mmZ format. The time must be in UTC
parameters.help_zh: 查询结束时间，必须晚于查询开始时间，格式为yyyy-MM-ddTHH:mmZ（UTC时间）
parameters.name: end_time

parameters.help_en:
Specifies whether to enable AOF persistence. Valid values:
0: Disabled.
1: Enabled.

Default value: 0
parameters.help_zh:
是否开启AoF落盘，取值：
0：关闭。
1：开启。

默认值：0
parameters.name: need_aof

AccessDeniedDetail.description_en: This group of parameters is deprecated. Ignore it
AccessDeniedDetail.description_zh: 本组参数已弃用，请忽略

Backup.description_en: The details of the backup set

items.description_en: The details of the backup set

BackupDBNames.description_en: The databases that are backed up. Default value: all, which indicates that all databases are backed up
BackupDBNames.description_zh: 备份的数据库，默认为all，即备份所有数据库

BackupDownloadURL.description_en: The public URL for downloading the backup file
BackupDownloadURL.description_zh: 备份文件的外网下载地址

BackupEndTime.description_en:
The end time of the backup.

The time is in the YYYY-MM-DDTHH:mm:ssZ format and displayed in UTC
BackupEndTime.description_zh:
备份结束时间。

格式为 YYYY-MM-DDTHH:mm:ssZ，使用 UTC 时间

BackupId.description_en: The ID of the backup file

BackupIntranetDownloadURL.description_en:
The internal URL for downloading the backup file.

You can use this URL to download the backup file from an ECS instance that is connected to the Tair instance. Both instances must reside in the same VPC
BackupIntranetDownloadURL.description_zh:
备份文件的内网下载地址。

您可以在与该实例连通的ECS（二者需属于同一VPC内）上使用该地址下载目标备份文件

BackupJobID.description_en: The ID of the backup job

BackupMethod.description_en:
The backup method. Valid values:
Logical: Logical backup.
Physical: Physical backup
BackupMethod.description_zh:
备份方法，返回值：
Logical：逻辑备份。
Physical：物理备份。

BackupMode.description_en:
The backup mode. Valid values:
Automated: Automatic backup.
Manual: Manual backup
BackupMode.description_zh:
备份模式，返回值：
Automated：自动备份。
Manual：手动备份。

BackupSize.description_en: The size of the backup file

BackupStartTime.description_en:
The start time of the backup.

The time is in the YYYY-MM-DDTHH:mm:ssZ format and displayed in UTC
BackupStartTime.description_zh:
备份开始时间。

格式为 YYYY-MM-DDTHH:mm:ssZ，使用 UTC 时间

BackupStatus.description_en:
The backup status. Valid values:
Success: The backup succeeded.
Failed: The backup failed
BackupStatus.description_zh:
备份状态，返回值：
Success：成功。
Failed：失败

BackupType.description_en:
The backup type. Valid values:
FullBackup: Full backup.
IncrementalBackup: Incremental backup
BackupType.description_zh:
备份类型，返回值：
FullBackup：全量备份。
IncrementalBackup：增量备份

EngineVersion.description_en: The database engine version, which is the version of the DPI engine that is compatible with Redis on the instance
EngineVersion.description_zh: 引擎版本，即实例兼容Redis的版本

ExpectExpireTime.description_en: The expiration time of the backup set. The time is in the yyyy-MM-ddTHH:mmZ format and displayed in UTC
ExpectExpireTime.description_zh: 备份集过期时间，格式为yyyy-MM-ddTHH:mmZ（UTC 时间）

NodeInstanceId.description_en:
The node ID.
If the instance uses the standard architecture, this parameter returns the instance ID
NodeInstanceId.description_zh:
节点ID。
当实例的架构为标准版时，本参数返回的是实例ID

RecoverConfigMode.description_en:
Indicates whether the backup set contains account, kernel parameter, and whitelist information.
This parameter is applicable only to cloud-native instances. If you modify the preceding information of the instance, such as creating an account or adding a whitelist, the modified information is included in subsequent backup sets through automatic backup
RecoverConfigMode.description_zh:
备份集中是否包含了账号（account）、内核参数（whitelist）、白名单（config）信息。
本参数仅适用于云原生版实例。若您修改实例的上述信息（例如新建了一个账号或添加了一个白名单），在后续的备份集中会自动备份上述信息

FreeSize.description_en:
<props="china">The free backup quota for the instance. Unit: bytes. The free quota is equal to the default memory capacity of the instance type. For more information, see [Notice on backup commercialization]（https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/2664017.html）.
Full backups and log backups share this free quota. When you change the instance type, the free quota of the instance changes accordingly.</props>
<props="intl">This parameter is not in effect. Ignore this parameter.</props>
FreeSize.description_zh:
<props="china">该实例的免费备份额度，单位是字节，免费额度为实例规格默认内存量，更多信息请参见[备份商业化通知]（https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/2664017.html）。
全量备份和日志备份共享该免费额度。当变配实例规格时，实例的免费额度会产生变化。</props>
<props="intl">该参数未生效，请忽略该参数。</props>

FullStorageSize.description_en:
The size of full backup files for the current instance. Unit: bytes. Full backups include daily scheduled backups, manual backups, and backups generated during cache analysis.
This value is independent of the number and size of backup sets returned in the current response. It represents the total size of all valid full backups for the instance
FullStorageSize.description_zh:
当前实例全量备份文件的大小，单位是字节。全量备份来源于每天定时备份、手动备份、缓存分析时生成的备份等。
该值和当前请求所响应的备份集数量以及大小无关，而是该实例当前所有有效全量备份的大小

LogStorageSize.description_en:
The size of instance log backup files for the current instance. Unit: bytes. This value is valid only when the flashback feature is enabled.
This value is independent of the number and size of backup sets returned in the current response. It represents the total size of all valid instance log backups for the instance
LogStorageSize.description_zh:
当前实例日志备份文件的大小，单位是字节，当且仅当开启闪回时才有效。
该值和当前请求所响应的备份集数量以及大小无关，而是该实例当前所有有效日志备份的大小

PageSize.description_en: The maximum number of entries per page
